author: GitHub
description:
GitHub issue fields are officially generally available for everyone. You can now bring structured, typed metadata to your issues to easily track priority, effort, dates, and custom values across all your repositories. Plus, with integration into the repo issues list, you can see all your metadata at a glance without opening individual issues. Watch to learn how to connect them to your existing tools using the GitHub MCP server.
